source.what: The transaction bytes of one real Monero mainnet block, captured for the block-to-transaction bridge (Lane B of the L4 master work order).
source.daemonVersion: the node answered get_info with no version string
source.transport: curl --socks5-hostname via 127.0.0.1:9050 (Tor; the node saw a Tor exit, not this machine)
source.rederive: CIPHER_XMR_NODE=xmr-node.cakewallet.com:18081 CIPHER_TOR_SOCKS=127.0.0.1:9050 node scripts/fetch-monero-block-fixture.mjs --height 3796965, then one REST /get_transactions call with the block's own claimedTxHashes; the list order here is that call's answer order, which the bridge test proves equals the block's walked order.
source.note: Each tx is the block hash-list entry of its index, claimed by the node and proven by the parser: the id computed from the bytes alone must equal claimedTxHashes[index]. The node claims (tx_hash, prunable_hash) are recorded as a stranger's claims and never trusted.
